title: Follow the download fallback
description: You inspect the genetic algorithm notebook's artifact download helper.

steps.description: You import archive and path tools before trying the Colab files import. Exceptions from the try block reach the handler below.
You create artifacts.zip and request its download when artifacts exists. Otherwise, the helper prints No artifacts folder found.

steps.question: Which message appears if the download call raises an exception?
steps.answer: The handler prints Colab download helper not available in this environment, followed by the exception text.

steps.description: You see that handler's message in the recording. It reports that google.colab.files.download is unavailable in code-viz.
